text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa didn't show up for 
training. Pondering what to do, I entered 
the Trainer's room, when—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sorry for slacking off on training, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I got so caught up in the match that I 
completely forgot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed truly remorseful, so I 
encouraged her, saying we'd keep doing our 
best together from now on.
